info.name: Project 25 - E-Commerce Backend (All 6 Members)
info.description: Postman collection built from the supplied ecommerce-management-system source ZIP and its actual Express routes/controllers. Import this file, then edit collection variables adminEmail/adminPassword to match your .env administrator credentials. Run Member 2 > Login Admin and Member 2 > Register User > Login User before protected requests. Run requests manually in order. Member 1 creates a fresh test category and product and stores their IDs automatically. Do not run Member 1 cleanup requests or Member 3 Clear Cart until Member 6 integration tests are complete. Member 5 Create Order requires the cart item prepared in Member 3. Payment tests create separate orders. The payment API is simulated only; no real money is processed. The collection uses the project's actual methods: PATCH for cart/stock/order status, POST for order cancellation, and Idempotency-Key for order creation.

item.name: Member 5 - Order Processing & Management
item.description: Create an unpaid order from the cart, view orders, update status, and cancel the unpaid order to verify stock restoration.

request.description: Creates an order from the customer's cart and reserves stock. Requires a non-empty cart and Idempotency-Key header. This order is used for the cancellation test.

item.name: Repeat Create Order with Same Idempotency Key

request.description: Send the same Idempotency-Key as the first Create Order request. Expected 200 and the existing order, not a duplicate.

exec: pm.test("Duplicate order request returns existing order", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Customers see their own orders; administrators can see all orders.
Retrieves the order created by the Create Order request.

Cancels an unpaid pending/confirmed order and restores its stock. This route uses POST, not PATCH.

item.name: Member 6 - Payment Simulation & Integration Testing
item.description: End-to-end successful and failed payment tests, duplicate payment protection, and stock restoration verification. Uses separate orders for success and failure.

item.name: Add Item for Successful Payment Test

request.description: Integration setup: add the product to the cart before creating the payment-success order.
Integration test: creates an unpaid order and saves successOrderId. Requires a non-empty cart and Idempotency-Key.
Simulates successful payment. No real money is processed.
Retrieves the payment record for the successful order.
Expected 409 because a payment has already been recorded for this order.

item.name: Add Item for Failed Payment Test

request.description: Integration setup: add the product to the cart before creating a second order for the failed-payment test.
Creates a second unpaid order and saves failureOrderId. Requires a non-empty cart and Idempotency-Key.
Simulates failed payment. The backend should cancel the order and restore stock.
Retrieves the failed payment record.
Checks that stock was restored after the failed payment.
Expected 400 because the order ID is not a valid MongoDB ObjectId.
